title: Enhanced Flame Retardant Property of Fiber Reactive Halogen-Free Organophosphonate
authors: Megumi Yoshioka-Tarver; Brian D. Condon; Michael Santiago Cintrón; SeChin Chang; Michael W. Easson; Chanel A. Fortier; Crista A. Madison; John M. Bland; Thach-Mien D. Nguyen
source_version: Published original article indexed from author upload; official publisher supporting information PDF
composition: Mercerized-bleached cotton twill, Testfabrics style #423; then desized and bleached before use. Areal density and thread counts not recovered from this source; none borrowed from other style #423 papers.
TGA_specimen_preparation: Own TGA of the numbered prepared cotton fabrics; nitrogen, 25–600 °C, 10 °C/min and 60 mL/min. Aliquot mass, cutting or grinding, pan and TG replicate count are not stated in the retrieved own TGA method. The separate MCC mass and triplicate method are not assigned to TGA.
source_material_form_TGA_raw: Section 3.3 and Figure 2 explicitly name treated fabrics 1–18; Table 3 provides matching numbered fabric rows. SI S2 defines the own TGA method.
LOI_method: ASTM D2863; SI reference 1 identifies ANSI/ASTM D2863-00. Instrument model and LOI replicate count unreported.
LOI_specimen_preparation: Cotton fabric strips 12.5 × 6 cm, SI S2. Fabric was conditioned overnight at 21 °C and 65% RH before each weighing; that statement is not silently extended to a separately specified LOI conditioning protocol.
source_numeric_evidence_description: Source Table 3 explicitly tabulates measured oxygen index, onset of degradation and remaining residue at 600 °C. Table 2 defines numbered preparation states. Main article indexed original text; no main PDF bytes or main figure-pixel verification. Official SI bytes and S2 pixels verified.
conditions_locator: Official SI S2 General method and S9 reference 1; main sections 2.2 and 3.2, pp 11032–11033
TG_locator: Table 3 and section 3.3, pp 11033–11034; official SI S2
LOI_locator: Table 3 and section 3.3, p 11034; official SI S2 and S9
source_location: Main original article pp 11031–11037, indexed author upload: identity, sections 2.1/2.2/3.1–3.5/4 and Tables 1–3 examined across cached original readouts; some intervening main text spans and figure pixels remain inaccessible. Complete official nine-page SI text examined; S2 method pixels inspected. No complete main-PDF or main-pixel claim.
source_wet_pickup_raw: 84.7 ± 1.1 wt%; source uncertainty type and replicate count unspecified
source_add_on_uncertainty_definition: Table 2 header ±ster %, with 2–10 replicates for fabrics 8–18. Retained source-native; not relabelled SD or transferred to LOI/TGA.
source_synthesis_raw: Section 2.1 reports TAHT 40.0 g, 16.4 mmol; dimethyl phosphite 5.0 mL, 5.5 mmol; chloroform 150 mL; DBU 2.0 mL, 1.4 mmol; reflux overnight; silica chromatography DCM/isopropanol 85:15; product 13.5 g, 75%. These native quantities are not converted or corrected. Product handled in isopropanol to avoid self-polymerization.
limitations: Ten treated source states are extracted under the disclosed original-evidence limits. Only exact own measured LOI and explicit TG are used. No MCC temperatures, heat release rates, vertical-flame char lengths or graph estimates are imported as TG. Table 3 defines onset of degradation, with no fixed mass-loss threshold or maximum-rate equivalence inferred. Own TGA nitrogen/ramp/flow/range come from official SI S2; MCC sample mass and three replicate measurements belong to the separate MCC assay. Table 2 and section 3.2 explicitly distinguish unwashed fabrics 1–7 from washed fabrics 8–18; the general section 2.2 wash description is preserved alongside that specific mapping. The washed group has a 20 min DI-water wash at 40 °C, described also as 10 min × 2, two cold DI-water rinses in section 3.2, and 80 °C drying for 5 min. Repeated treatment counts represent complete treatment, cure, wash and weighing cycles, not extra independent durability washes. Fabric 2 is held for LOI 26 versus prose 27; fabric 10 LOI 27–28 is a range and is held. Fabric 1 has an exact numeric pair but its individual formulation/add-on row was not recovered, so it stays held. Fabric 14 residue is 27.1 in Table 3 versus indexed prose 271; no decimal repair is assumed. The absolute Table 3 onsets for fabrics 10–16 do not agree arithmetically with their listed reductions from the Table 3 control by 0.2 °C; affected canonical onsets stay blank and native values remain raw. Fabric 14 consequently has no retained canonical TG and stays held. Fabric 11 is consistently the two-cycle sodium-carbonate state, but add-on is 14.5 ± 0.3 in Table 2/thermal discussion versus 13.9 in the FTIR discussion and SI Figure S5; no single canonical add-on is assigned. HCl is 2 N in the specific section 3.2 recipe versus generic 5% catalyst wording in section 2.2; both are retained without conversion. Control is held for conservative family QA: related AATCC Review 2012 gives the same LOI 21, same style #423 and TG method, with onset 337.7 and residue 0.36 versus this source 337.2 and 0.4. This near coincidence is not proof of identical measurements, and distinct treated chemistries are not excluded. Source-specific reuse screening found no exact paired-observation match; the related 2009 and 2016 sources remain excluded under their unresolved identifiers. Direct main article retrieval is restricted; original indexed text is cached, while only the official SI has a document hash. Main table and figure pixels have not been verified.
sample_state: Fabric 3; DHTP cotton twill; 1 treatment cycle(s); unwashed after curing
washing_state: No wash in source Table 2; unwashed cured state in the specific section 3.2 fabrics 1–7 group
source_DHTP_bath_raw: Different aqueous DHTP I concentrations; this individual bath concentration is not numerically specified in the recovered text
treatment_method: Mercerized-bleached Testfabrics cotton twill #423 was desized and bleached before use. DHTP I in a small amount of isopropanol was diluted with DI water. Soak in the source-varied aqueous concentration for 1 h at 40 °C, pad to wet pickup 84.7 ± 1.1%, and cure 160 °C for 3 min. Table 2 states one treatment and no washing for this numbered state. Do not apply the washed 8–18 procedure or invent its unreported individual bath concentration. Condition overnight at 21 °C and 65% RH before weighing.
pairing_evidence: Table 2 identifies fabric 3, catalyst None, 1 treatment cycle(s), and washing no. Table 3 repeats fabric 3 with measured LOI 28% and explicit residue 23.7% at 600 °C. Source onset of degradation 311.1 °C is also retained. Both assays use the corresponding prepared cotton fabric state; no additional laundry or MCC specimen is substituted.

limitations: Ten treated source states are extracted under the disclosed original-evidence limits. Only exact own measured LOI and explicit TG are used. No MCC temperatures, heat release rates, vertical-flame char lengths or graph estimates are imported as TG. Table 3 defines onset of degradation, with no fixed mass-loss threshold or maximum-rate equivalence inferred. Own TGA nitrogen/ramp/flow/range come from official SI S2; MCC sample mass and three replicate measurements belong to the separate MCC assay. Table 2 and section 3.2 explicitly distinguish unwashed fabrics 1–7 from washed fabrics 8–18; the general section 2.2 wash description is preserved alongside that specific mapping. The washed group has a 20 min DI-water wash at 40 °C, described also as 10 min × 2, two cold DI-water rinses in section 3.2, and 80 °C drying for 5 min. Repeated treatment counts represent complete treatment, cure, wash and weighing cycles, not extra independent durability washes. Fabric 2 is held for LOI 26 versus prose 27; fabric 10 LOI 27–28 is a range and is held. Fabric 1 has an exact numeric pair but its individual formulation/add-on row was not recovered, so it stays held. Fabric 14 residue is 27.1 in Table 3 versus indexed prose 271; no decimal repair is assumed. The absolute Table 3 onsets for fabrics 10–16 do not agree arithmetically with their listed reductions from the Table 3 control by 0.2 °C; affected canonical onsets stay blank and native values remain raw. Fabric 14 consequently has no retained canonical TG and stays held. Fabric 11 is consistently the two-cycle sodium-carbonate state, but add-on is 14.5 ± 0.3 in Table 2/thermal discussion versus 13.9 in the FTIR discussion and SI Figure S5; no single canonical add-on is assigned. HCl is 2 N in the specific section 3.2 recipe versus generic 5% catalyst wording in section 2.2; both are retained without conversion. Control is held for conservative family QA: related AATCC Review 2012 gives the same LOI 21, same style #423 and TG method, with onset 337.7 and residue 0.36 versus this source 337.2 and 0.4. This near coincidence is not proof of identical measurements, and distinct treated chemistries are not excluded. Source-specific reuse screening found no exact paired-observation match; the related 2009 and 2016 sources remain excluded under their unresolved identifiers. Direct main article retrieval is restricted; original indexed text is cached, while only the official SI has a document hash. Main table and figure pixels have not been verified. The recovered section 3.2 continuation reports that the strong Brønsted base NaOH and acid HCl increased discoloration and weakened the fabrics during curing, with source-reported fixation of 32–36%. This material limitation applies to the present HCl/NaOH-treated state; fixation is not substituted for retained add-on or TG residue.

washing_state: Preparation-washed after each treatment/cure cycle; 40 °C DI water 20 min, two cold DI-water rinses, 80 °C drying 5 min; no later home laundering assigned
treatment_method: Mercerized-bleached Testfabrics cotton twill #423 was desized and bleached before use. DHTP I in a small amount of isopropanol was diluted to 20 w/w % with 5 w/w % aqueous NaOH. Soak 1 h at 40 °C, pad to source wet pickup 84.7 ± 1.1%, and cure 160 °C for 3 min. Wash in DI water at 40 °C for 20 min, also described as 10 min × 2; rinse twice with cold DI water and dry 80 °C for 5 min. Repeat the complete treatment/cure/wash/weighing procedure for the 2 cycles stated for fabric 18 in Table 2. Condition overnight at 21 °C and 65% RH before weighing.
